entry.title: Chicago Union Station

groundCutout.basis: Exact main headhouse occupied floor only,including the closed Great Hall below its recessed skylight. No blanket cutout across the projecting Canal arcade,adjacent roads,underground concourse or independent office buildings.

buildingCutout.basis: Whole individual above-ground Chicago Union Station historic headhouse and physically attached mapped Canal Street arcade/canopy. Preserve the separate underground concourse east of Canal, independent modern offices, public roads and surrounding buildings. Author all four exterior fronts and the actual roof/service masses after resolving the roof layout; no invented extra station platforms, copied lettering, advertising, people, trains or navigable interiors. Retained exact-Q way/203442440 identifies Q1155989. The long axis is N/S: signed +X south toward Jackson Boulevard; -X north toward Adams Street; +Z west toward Clinton; -Z east toward Canal Street. Current PMTiles supplies the whole main building35184575531272 with height26m and attached long Canal strip35184815348058,layer1. The two ordinary street photographs show the Canal lower pilaster/door front and Jackson round-column colonnade, heavy entablature/friezes, arched corner entries, corner clocks, upper repeated rectangular windows/pilasters, narrow attic windows and a stepped rooftop service block. They do not establish the complete hidden roof/courtyard inventory; resolve that with an ordinary roof picture or available map geometry before authoring. Retained8levels and current native26m envelope are source controls, not surveyed facade/tower levels. Two additional ordinary rooftop photographs were inspected: a segmental barrel-vaulted Great Hall skylight is recessed inside four surrounding office wings. Model roof court x+-35,z+-25 and glass x+-33,z+-15 are picture-scale interpretations; hidden services and exact measured dimensions remain unverified. Use estimated exterior parapet35.2m,penthouse39m,skylight eaves21.5m/crest28.5m; native26m remains a conflicting coarse map control. One unchanged outside Jackson/Canal street reference[66,-55],179.7933694m absolute,sets Y=0. No bespoke surveys or archival research.
